decisions.disposition: No minimum room dimension or blackout claim is authoritative until a venue measures and approves it.
Scrim remains one candidate surface material; the canonical twin uses unassigned reference planes and requires venue surface receipts.
Two logical outputs exercise the synchronization contract, but make no equipment, lens, brightness, throw, mounting, or routing claim.
Hard boundaries and zero overlap are retained as the reference artistic policy; a physical assignment still requires venue approval and measurement.
The local opt-in interaction adapter, permission-denied path, dropout behavior, accessibility fallback, and no-camera mode supersede a mandatory camera.
The vendored local model and anonymous bounded feature receipt supersede CDN loading and raw landmark transport.
Bounded visitor openness and crowd features modulate divergence and spread outside the pure engine; no raw skeletal geometry enters the engine.
The deterministic typed room-event bus and venue-gated speaker plan replace direct mutable panning from a visitor coordinate.
